title: Incorrect type conversion logic
detail: The conversion logic incorrectly decodes when the target type is not str and encodes when it is bytes, reversing the intended behavior. This causes wrong types to be returned for non‑str/bytes path types.
note: Describes the planted negation: decoding happens when the type is not str.

title: Incorrect root detection logic
detail: The function is supposed to return True when the path resolves to the filesystem root, but the comparison `resolved != resolved.parent` returns False for the root (since its parent is itself). This causes the warning in `main` never to be emitted for the root directory.
note: Names the planted `!=`: the root is no longer reported as the root.
